Look no further than becoming an NSU Art Museum member! Our memberships offer access to our world-renowned exhibitions, engaging events, and educational programs. Plus, you’ll receive special discounts at our Museum Store and Café. Seize this opportunity to become a part of our vibrant community of art enthusiasts. Join us today and start experiencing all that NSU Art Museum has to offer! BECOME A MEMBER NSU Students and Faculty receive FREE transportation offered through the NSU Shuttle Bus. Check here for schedule . Bring headphones and download our mobile guide on Bloomberg Connects, the free arts and culture app to get the most from your visit. LEARN MORE Blue Star Museums NSU Art Museum is proud to participate in the Blue Star Museums program, offering FREE admission to the nation’s active-duty military personnel and their families, including National Guard and Reserve. The 2026 program begins on Armed Forces Day, Saturday, May 16, 2026, and runs through Labor Day, September 7, 2026. The program is a collaboration among the National Endowment for the Arts, Blue Star Families, the Department of Defense, and thousands of museums across the country. Museums for All NSU Art Museum provides FREE admission to individuals and families presenting a Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) card, and a valid form of photo ID. FREE admission is offered to four individuals per EBT card. Bank of America Museums on Us Bank of America cardholders receive free admission on the first full weekend of each month. Group Tours Tours are available for groups by contacting the group sales office at 954-262-0204 or email us at the link below.
